Name: Ezer, Captain of Gad
Summary: First captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:9: First captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
